summary: Ex-bitcoin miner pivoting to AI cloud (GPU rental). Q1 FY27 revenue $228M, ~$1B operating ARR, $20B backlog, >$4B ARR target slipped to early 2027, ~$20B capex plan funded with debt. Very high growth but very capital-hungry and execution-risky. Note: even with these assumptions the DCF comes out well below the price, because the debt already taken on is large relative to today's revenue. The price is a bet on the ramp; use the bull case and the 5-year target to judge it.

rationale.growthHigh: From under $1B trailing revenue to the $4B+ ARR target in early 2027, then slower growth on a $20B backlog: ~55% a year averages out the front-loaded ramp.
rationale.targetMargin: GPU cloud operating margin after heavy depreciation; peers (CoreWeave) run ~20-30%.
rationale.marginConvergenceYear: Margin reaches steady state once contracted clusters are running (about year 4).
rationale.salesToCapital: Headline capex is ~$20B, but much of the current build is already financed by the ~$10B of debt on the balance sheet, so each new $1 of capital supports ~$1 of extra revenue.
rationale.failureProbability: 10%: large debt-funded build-out, customer concentration and GPU obsolescence risk.
rationale.distressProceeds: Data centres and power sites keep some value in a distress sale.
rationale.exitMultiple: 18x: capital-intensive infrastructure earnings deserve a lower multiple than software.
rationale.waccInitial: ~12%: high-beta stock (~2) on a 4.5% equity risk premium, blended with ~8% secured GPU financing. The automatic figure is higher because trailing losses give a poor synthetic credit rating.

thesis.text: IREN is turning cheap renewable-powered data-centre sites into an AI cloud. The contracted backlog ($20B) is real, but the business must finance ~$20B of GPUs and deliver on time; the equity is a leveraged bet on that ramp.
bull: $20.3B revenue backlog and ~$1B operating ARR, targeting >$4B in early 2027
Owns powered land (Childress, Sweetwater) that is scarce
bear: Heavy debt and dilution to fund GPU purchases
The $4B ARR target already slipped once
Still loss-making on a GAAP basis
watch: Financing terms for the remaining capex

changes.text: First Claude base case and thesis.
